tests.procedure: To 10 mL of Sample in a stoppered tube, add 10 mL of alcohol, shake vigorously for 1 min at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min. Then to another 10 mL of sample, add 10 mL water at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C and shake vigorously for 1 min.

tests.procedure: The relative density is the ratio of mass of a certain volume of substance at t1 to mass of equal volume of water at t2. Weigh Empty Pycnometer (W1). Fill Pycnometer with water to mark without air bubbles, weigh at t2° (W2). Fill Pycnometer with Sample to mark without air bubbles, weigh at t1° (W3). Relative density = (W3 - W1) / (W2 - W1).

details.reference: BP Appendix V G. Determination of Weight per Millilitre, Density, Relative Density and Apparent Density
